fields.summary_ko.0: With Jensen Huang returning as Nvidia CEO, Asian semiconductor stocks including TSMC, Samsung, and SK Hynix surged, intensifying AI trading, with Samsung and SK Hynix rising 6.9% in Seoul and KOSPI up 6.3%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Melius Research upgraded NVDA to 'Buy' (target price $220), and Bernstein also upgraded to 'Outperform' (target price $200), citing easing of long-term concerns.
fields.summary_ko.2: Analyst Ming-Chi Kuo warns that while Huang's return removes a major overhang, multiple risks remain including strengthened U.S. export controls, increased compliance costs, and ongoing investigations.
